title: Lark Video Player
summary: Offline video player for HD video, 4K & major formats, share video, play as mp3
description:
🌟 A light & powerful offline video player, with full HD video & major formats supported. 											
🌟 You can play offline video in a video pop-up, also to play video as MP3.
🌟 It loads video subtitles, and also work as a powerful media file manager.
									
Key features:	
											
💿 HD, ultra HD video												
	HD video, Full HD video, Ultra HD video all run smoothly, experience the ultimate in offline video playback with Lark Video Player. 	
										
🎥 All formats												
	It's compatible with major formats, including mkv, mp4, m4v, mov, 3gp, 3gp2, mpg2, ts, webm etc. 		
									
📲 Video popup												
	Tired of interruptions while watching videos? Lark Video Player covers video popup feature. Enjoy stable floating video playback  even while multitasking or using other apps on your device.			

🔒Keep videos in the private folder        
        Hide your videos in a private folder to protect your privacy, set password for the private folder.
								
🎧 Play offline video as MP3												
	When you're occupied, you can listen to the video by playing video as audio in the background. 						
					
📁 Manage media files											
	Organizing video files has never been easier. The HD video player allows you to search, manage your video files & other media files effortlessly, with auto sorting by folders and by categories. 			
								
👆🏻 Gestures & one click to control 												
	Adjust progress, brightness, video volume, speed, auto-rotate, items to be played, etc with gestures or one click.
									
🕶️ Light & stylish video player												
	Play your videos with this lightweight and stylish offline video player, takes less space in your device.
									
🎵 offline player for HQ music												
	Manage and listen to offline music files, with cool sound effect. The offline player make it one-stop for music & video play when there is no network. 
											
It's a feature-packed, high-quality offline video player for Android. Start to play video, experience the smooth & clean HD video playback with this offline video player now. 
If any suggestions please contact with Lark Video Player dev team in 'Setting' - 'Feedback'.
developer: Lark Player Studio - Video, MP4 & Music Player
